originality.rationale: The general stationary mixture and Brownian-reset framework are prior work. The new object-level mathematical claim is the exact optimum over all strictly positive i.i.d. renewal intervals of fixed mean at nonzero spatial x, with a universal tangent equation, unique/absent optimizers and zero infimum. Primary full-text comparisons and targeted published research-index and scholarly searches found no equivalent or stronger covering theorem. General concave-envelope optimization theory may subsume the proof method, but the special Gaussian transition is not present in inspected resetting results.

A nontrivial universal target-distance phase boundary selects either unique deterministic resetting or approximating bursty/long two-point reset clocks; the exact envelope and nonattainment classification give a meaningful complete law beyond known reset density representations.
